app.title: Adtek Traceability Hub
app.desc: As the group-level, centralized and trusted serial number (SN) control foundation, the Traceability Hub serves distributed manufacturing across production orgs. It builds one SN lifecycle governance system that coordinates SN resource allocation, rule distribution, generation and delivery, validation and interception, and closed-loop traceability for every factory and line order in the group, preventing duplicate, wrong and missing SNs at the source. SN resources across plants are standardized, centralized and trusted, supporting manufacturing quality compliance and digital supply-chain collaboration.
app.subtitle: Adtek · group SN control

login.lead: The group-level, centralized and trusted SN control foundation: SN rule distribution, generation and delivery, validation and closed-loop traceability for every factory and line order, preventing duplicate, wrong and missing SNs at the source.

allocate.desc: Allocate generated SNs to the order's production org (a whole PI or the ticked lines): MES orgs get them pushed batch by batch automatically, and an interrupted push can be resumed; allocated SNs can be viewed one by one and downloaded as xlsx on the “Allocated” tab, with or without MES.

allocate.toGenerate: {n} more to generate · go to generation
allocate.skippedN: {n} bills will be skipped (frozen, unapproved or suspended)
allocate.allocConfirmPush: Allocate {n} SNs? The MES part will be pushed in {m} batches automatically.
allocate.allocSkipped: {n} bills were skipped (frozen, unapproved or suspended)

batch.confirmTip: Use only when MES confirms in writing that everything was processed but cannot send a receipt: the batch becomes succeeded (confirmed manually) and is not retried; SNs of a delivery batch become pushed.
batch.voidTip: Only for batches MES has not processed: SNs of a delivery batch go back to to-push (unbatched) and are re-batched; a transfer-out batch is rebuilt from its items and pushed automatically.

factories.title: Production orgs
factories.desc: Production org master data comes only from Kingdee and is synced once when this page opens; this system only maintains each org's MES integration settings. SN ownership follows the org code on the order; names are for display only.
factories.name: Name
factories.batchSizeHint: Also the cap for batches built on MES pull
factories.seconds: seconds; on timeout the batch stays unconfirmed and retries after 1 / 5 / 15 min
factories.concurrencyHint: Push tasks running at once (across PIs); the rest queue
factories.tzHint: Time zone for page times and “today” statistics of this org's accounts
factories.enabledEditHint: Integration is on: after changing the endpoint, auth type, credential or gzip compression, the new settings must pass the connection test before saving
factories.authNoneHint: Pushes carry no auth header and need no credential; use only when MES is on the intranet and restricts access itself (e.g. by source IP)
factories.gzipHint: Plain JSON by default; when on, the push request body is gzip-compressed (with Content-Encoding: gzip) and MES must support it
factories.credentialKeep: Set; leave empty to keep the stored credential
factories.credentialHint: Used when SN calls MES; stored encrypted and never shown; separate from the interface account MES uses to call this system
factories.enableBlocked: Fill in the endpoint and credential (not needed with no auth) and pass the connection test first (under MES settings)
factories.enableEffect: After turning on, {n} allocated SNs of this org become to-push (not batched) and are not pushed automatically; resume pushing on the allocation page or let MES pull them.
factories.disableEffect: After turning off, {n} to-push (not batched) SNs of this org become allocated (still downloadable on SN allocation); pushed SNs stay as they are, and the endpoint and credential are kept (transfer-outs still get pushed).
factories.disableBlocked: Unfinished pushes remain; cannot turn off
factories.disableBlockedHint: Resume pushing or wait for MES receipts first; if MES is out of service, confirm or void the remaining batches manually under delivery batches.
factories.disableHint: Production orgs disabled in Kingdee cannot be bound to accounts or chosen as transfer targets; SNs already allocated to them can still be exported, pushed, pulled and transferred out.

generate.title: SN generation
generate.desc: Generate SNs per PI: complete the SN rule and attachment item of each material line, then tick lines and generate (each line gets its whole quota at once, all SNs share the PI's serial); revoking is also per line, from the end of the serial backwards. Generated SNs are allocated on the “SN allocation” page.
generate.recentOnly: Only the latest {n} pages are listed; search for older PIs
generate.capped: At most {n} PIs are fetched ({n}+); narrow down with search
generate.unbindPiConfirm: After unbinding the rule becomes a general template; lines that already picked a rule are not affected. Unbind?

plan.CLAIM: Will be claimed by this PI

rule.changeConfirm: Some selected lines already have SNs. Change the rule?

generate.noLines: This bill is no longer in the snapshot; only its SNs can be viewed
generate.unitChinese: The unit cannot contain Chinese characters; enter e.g. M, m, L
generate.lengthChinese: The length cannot contain Chinese characters
generate.genCanceled: Generation canceled; all written SNs were deleted
generate.cancelConfirm: Canceling deletes all written SNs and restores the PI max and generated counts. Cancel?
generate.toAllocate: {n} SNs to allocate · go to SN allocation
generate.revokeConfigConfirm: Revoke the config of {n} material line(s): the line's selected rule goes back to the PI / customer default, the manually filled attachment item is cleared, and the manually filled length and unit go back to the Kingdee values.
generate.unlock: Over the default per-run limit {limit}; lift it
generate.attachAutoSaved: Filled the attachment no. of {n} line(s) in click order; you can change them in the table

groups.title: User groups
groups.desc: Permissions by functional module: each user belongs to one user group (the account's role), which decides the modules it can use; operators and auditors are further limited to their authorized production orgs. Set roles and orgs on the “Users” page.
groups.note: MES interface accounts never sign in to pages and only call the MES APIs of their org; user groups follow the same rules as the menu and API permissions.

departments.title: Production departments
departments.desc: Production workshops from Kingdee production order lines, listed by production org (read-only; department master data is maintained in Kingdee); updated with order sync.

departments.empty: No departments in the order snapshot yet (the Kingdee lines have no workshop, or not synced yet)

orders.title: Production order snapshot
orders.desc: Approved Kingdee production orders, stored per material line (bill + line No.); sync with Kingdee manually at any time. Top: totals per bill; bottom: material lines of the selected bill. Bills without a customer are shown and processed as usual.
orders.rebuildConfirm: A full rebuild fetches all approved Kingdee production orders and replaces the snapshot as a whole (the old snapshot is kept on failure); it may take long for large data. Use it for the first import or when the snapshot seems inconsistent with Kingdee. Continue?
orders.compareDone: Compare sync done: {replaced} replaced, {removed} removed, {rows} lines

outcome.NOT_APPROVED: Bill {bill} is not approved in Kingdee (status {status}); removed from the snapshot
outcome.NOT_APPROVED_NEW: Bill {bill} is not approved in Kingdee (status {status}); not added to the snapshot

orders.syncFailed: The last compare sync failed ({time}): {msg}; the list shows the old snapshot
orders.attachConflict: Kingdee now has {k3} (entered {manual}); generation uses the Kingdee value
orders.attachInvalid: Attachment item cannot be empty, at most 64 characters

actionHint.CONFIRM: Confirm the change of bill {bill}: frozen generation and suspended delivery are lifted, and later generation and allocation follow the current snapshot. Allocated SNs are not moved automatically; transfer them to another org first if needed. Continue?
actionHint.UNRELATED: Confirm the lost material line of bill {bill} is unrelated to the new lines: its generated count stays, and new lines can be generated normally. Continue?

orders.voidHint: Confirm the bill is actually voided in Kingdee: suspension is lifted, SNs to allocate go to the production org recorded at generation, allocated SNs are delivered as usual, and the bill is no longer re-checked. Enter the reason.
orders.mapHint: The generated count of lost line {seq} (former material {material}) of bill {bill} is merged into the line chosen below, and its SNs move to that line; SNs already delivered to MES are re-pushed as reassignments.

query.title: SN query
query.desc: Read-only lookup of SN details, delivery batches (push, pull, transfer-out) and delivery alerts, filtered by the production orgs your account can see; SNs cannot be moved from this page.
query.piAllTip: Read-only view of this PI's SNs across production orgs
query.seqRangeTip: A PI is required for a serial range; both ends are inclusive, leaving one end empty means unbounded; only serials generated by this PI are searched.
query.rangeMissing: The range should have {expected}; {n} are not in the results (in other orgs, transferred or not generated)
query.rangeFull: Every SN of the range is in the results

rules.title: SN rule library
rules.desc: Maintain SN rules: SN = prefix + serial within the PI (zero-padded) + separator + length (zero-padded, optional) + separator + unit (optional) + suffix, any characters allowed. A rule is bound to a PI only, and the PI is required when creating it. Rules are only maintained here; choosing rules for material lines and binding a PI's default rule happen on the generation page.
rules.ownerHint: Empty = global rule: every org may use it, only the system administrator can modify or delete it
rules.ownerOperatorHint: The rule belongs to the chosen authorized org; only that org's accounts and the system administrator can see and modify it
rules.globalReadonly: Only the system administrator can modify or delete global rules; operators can only use them
rules.piHint: Required; a rule is bound to a PI only, and is recommended first when choosing rules for that PI on the generation page
rules.codeHint: 1–64 letters, digits, _ or -; cannot change later
rules.name: Name
rules.withLengthHint: SN contains the material line's length as text (000 when empty; lengths with Chinese must be edited on the generation page first)
rules.lengthPadHint: Pads the length with leading zeros to this width (5: 51.5 → 051.5); longer values are kept; 0 = no padding
rules.sepHint: Optional, at most 16 characters each, any characters
rules.withUnitHint: SN contains the material line's product unit (Kingdee FProductUnit as is; lines without a unit cannot be generated)
rules.prefixHint: Required, any characters (case-sensitive); must not equal any rule's prefix (old versions included). Sharing a leading part, e.g. SD and SDD, is allowed
rules.charsetHint: Leave empty for the default charset (its first character, 0, is used for padding); a custom one must not contain spaces and needs as many unique characters as the base
rules.hintIN_PLACE: The current version has never generated SNs: saving edits it in place
rules.hintNEW_VERSION: The current version has generated SNs: changing the format creates a new version with a new prefix, used only for SNs generated later
rules.hintUSED: The current version has generated SNs: changing only the name or PI keeps the version
rules.deleteBlocked: Rules that generated SNs or are assigned to a PI cannot be deleted
rules.deleteConfirm: Delete rule {code} ({name}) and all its versions?

transfer.title: SN transfer

blocked.PENDING_ALLOC: To allocate (only allocated SNs can be transferred)
blocked.TRANSFER_OUT_PENDING: Transfer-out unfinished; resume it on the original org transfer first

transfer.noMes: No MES: download on the SN allocation page
transfer.desc: Re-attach SNs to another production order or org; SN strings never change. A new transfer does not ask for the kind: fill in the source and target and the system decides — a new bill keeping that bill's org is recorded as a bill transfer, a different org (or a new org within the same bill) as an org transfer. System admins and operators both transfer directly, effective at once, with a required transfer reason; only allocated SNs can be transferred; operators need the source authorized, while the target is unrestricted. MES is informed by automatic reassign / transfer-out pushes.
transfer.noBillInPi: No bills of this PI in the snapshot
transfer.targetOutOfScope: The target org is outside your authorization: the transfer is allowed, but you cannot act on these SNs afterwards.
transfer.locatePlaceholder: Enter a full SN, bill No. or PI and press Enter to fill in the source

located.SN: PI, bill, material, org and start SN filled in

transfer.autoMatchHint: Matched from the source material code; pick the line No. when the material has several lines
transfer.orgDefault: Defaults to the target bill's org; any enabled org may be chosen
transfer.orgDiff: Differs from the target bill's org: handled as an org transfer
transfer.confirm: Recorded as {kind}: re-attach {n} SNs to {to} · PI {pi} · bill {bill} / line {seq}. This takes effect at once.
transfer.confirmXo: {n} SNs will be pushed to the source MES as transferred out.
transfer.nothingTransferable: No transferable SNs in the selected scope: {detail}
transfer.reasonPlaceholder: Required: why are these SNs moved (at most 500 characters)
transfer.reasonTip: Direct transfer, effective at once; the reason is kept on the transfer document and in the audit trail

users.empNoHint: 4–32 letters and digits; cannot change later
users.name: Name

roleHint.operator: Authorized for one or more production orgs: production orders, SN generation, allocation, rule library (global rules are use-only), transfers, delivery handling, SN export and query
roleHint.auditor: Read-only; authorized for one or more production orgs: SN query and export, operation log
roleHint.mes: Can only call the MES pull, receipt and read-only APIs of its org

users.lockedUntil: Too many failed secret checks; locked until {time}
users.disableConfirm: Disable account {emp} ({name})? It can no longer sign in or call the API, and can be re-enabled.
users.resetPrompt: New password for {emp} (pages signed in with it sign out; sign in again with the new password)
users.ipHint: IPs or CIDRs separated by commas; empty = any. When set, only requests from the list are accepted
users.mesFactoryHint: You can create the account and hand it to MES for joint testing before turning MES integration on; until then it can only pull transfer-out batches, submit receipts and run read-only queries
users.secretWillShow: A secret is generated on save; you can view or reset it any time
users.secretKeep: After closing, use “View secret” in the list to see it again, or “Reset secret” to generate a new one; hand it to the MES side and keep it safe
users.secretUsage: MES sends the header Authorization: Bearer <employee No.>:<secret> on every call; no token exchange.
users.resetSecretConfirm: Reset the secret of {emp}? The old secret stops working at once; MES must switch to the new secret.
